name: facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/C.create_classifier: create a Classifier instance with samples, dimensions, and SVM kernel type for Bayesian optimization
facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/C.train_gpr: train the Gaussian Process Regressor on samples to learn the surrogate model
facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/C.propose_samples_bo: propose new samples using Bayesian optimization with expected improvement acquisition function
facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/C.split_data: split samples into good and bad clusters using KMeans and SVM boundary learning
facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/C.expected_improvement: compute expected improvement values at candidate points using the fitted GPR model

facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/M.create_MCTS_optimizer: create an MCTS optimizer instance with lower bounds, upper bounds, dimensions, initial samples, and an objective function
facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/M.run_MCTS_search: run the MCTS search loop for a given number of iterations using Bayesian optimization or turbo solver

facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/M.select_MCTS_leaf: select a leaf node from the MCTS tree using UCT scores for exploration and exploitation balance
facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/M.collect_MCTS_samples: collect and evaluate a sample point, update the current best value, and append to the samples list

facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/N.create_Node: create a Node instance with optional parent, dimensions, kernel type, and gamma type for LA-MCTS tree search
facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/N.update_bag_Node: update a Node's bag with samples to retrain its classifier and compute mean value and splittability

facebookresearch_lamcts/LA-MCTS/lamcts/u.transform_unit_cube_to_bounds: transform unit cube points to custom lower and upper bounds using from_unit_cube
